summary: FAIL. The D-038 repairs hold for what they target. The shallow refusal works and a disguised shallow clone fails closed. Retained and gate rounds reject every malformed or absent head/fix. The record-less drop exemption is gone and F-DG0-238 is imported. Prototype-named keys are rejected. Tests (99+22) and prefreeze pass in a fresh clone. I re-verified and closed F-DG0-150/151/158/159/160/161/162/163. New: F-DG0-164 (Medium). The 'round absent' escape is keyed on a forgeable manifest source_commit and on object-store membership: a superseded round with a non-existent source_commit lets a High/mandatory closure carry an all-zero or typo'd fix_revision with no gate-ancestry check, and verdicts differ between clones holding different unreachable objects. Since shallow clones are now refused, an absent fix can never be in the gate candidate, and after this round no real closure needs the tolerance. F-DG0-165 (Low): unbound later-round findings sidecars can supersede a finding's immutable severity/mandatory fields.
